objective_for_doctor:
Age: 17
Sex: F
Chief Complaint: loss of consciousness

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

I’ve lost consciousness, and I’ve also been coughing up blood, having significant shortness of breath, and chest pain (sharp, intensity 4/10) on both sides of my chest and posterior chest wall, with pain involving my scapula on both sides.
Thank you for that information. To help narrow this down, have you noticed any swelling, pain, or redness in either of your legs recently?
Yes—there’s swelling in the posterior aspect of my ankle on the right side.
Have you had any recent prolonged immobility, long-distance travel, surgery, or significant trauma within the past 4 weeks?

Yes. Within the last 4 weeks I’ve been unable to move or get up for more than 3 consecutive days, and I had surgery within the last month. I also traveled out of the country to North America in the last 4 weeks.
[DDX] Pulmonary embolism, Deep vein thrombosis, Pneumonia, Acute coronary syndrome, Aortic dissection
